resources.name: 2-1-1 Orange County
resources.description: OC's 24/7 info and referral line for health, housing, food, and human services. Front door for shelter via Coordinated Entry.

resources.name: OC Links — Orange County Behavioral Health Line
resources.description: County navigation line for mental health and substance use services. Trained staff connect callers to county and community programs.

resources.name: Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
resources.description: Free, 24/7 crisis support by phone or text. Any mental health crisis, not just suicide.

resources.name: Crisis Text Line
resources.description: Text-based crisis support, 24/7. Good when talking out loud isn't safe or possible.

resources.name: National Domestic Violence Hotline
resources.description: 24/7 support, safety planning, and local DV shelter referrals. Interpreters available.

resources.name: SAMHSA National Helpline
resources.description: Free, confidential, 24/7 treatment referral for substance use and mental health.

resources.name: National Runaway Safeline
resources.description: 24/7 for youth running away, on the street, or wanting to come home. Free rides home for eligible youth.

resources.name: RAINN Sexual Assault Hotline
resources.description: 24/7 support for survivors of sexual violence, with local referrals.

resources.name: The Trevor Project
resources.description: 24/7 crisis support for LGBTQ young people.

resources.name: Trans Lifeline
resources.description: Peer support by and for trans people, in crisis or not.

resources.name: Veterans Crisis Line
resources.description: 24/7 confidential crisis support for veterans and families. Dial 988 then press 1, or text 838255.

resources.name: VA Benefits
resources.description: Federal VA benefits information and enrollment.

resources.name: Social Security Administration
resources.description: SSI/SSDI applications, replacement Social Security cards.

resources.name: California DMV — Fee-Waived ID for Homeless Californians
resources.description: People experiencing homelessness can get a no-fee California ID card. Ask for the homeless ID fee waiver at any DMV office.

resources.name: BenefitsCal
resources.description: One online application for CalFresh (food stamps), Medi-Cal, and CalWORKs. Works on a phone browser.

resources.name: Orange County Social Services Agency
resources.description: County office for CalFresh, CalWORKs, General Relief cash aid, and Medi-Cal applications. Multiple regional offices.
